definitions.explanation: A long, straight section of bamboo used as a pole — for laundry, fishing, vaulting, or supporting plants. Often written {竹竿|たけざお} with kanji.

examples.japanese: {竹|たけ}ざお⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: To hang laundry on a bamboo pole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{竹|たけ}ざお⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{釣|つ}り{糸|いと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I attached fishing line to the end of a long bamboo pole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧{竹|たけ}ざお⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てた→当てる：01864_ateru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: In the old days, people would drape futons over bamboo poles in the yard to air them in the sun.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧ (bamboo) + ⟦{竿|さお}→竿：24133_sao⟧ (pole, rod). Note the rendaku: さお → ざお. Often written with the kanji {竹竿|たけざお}.

USAGE:
A traditional household and outdoor tool. Familiar Japanese sights: laundry hung on a {竹|たけ}ざお stretched between two posts, the long pole used by the {竹|たけ}ざお⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧ (itinerant bamboo-pole seller, whose distinctive call was once common in residential neighborhoods).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竹|たけ}ざお⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up a bamboo pole
- {竹|たけ}ざお⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to hang on a bamboo pole
- ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{竹|たけ}ざお: a bamboo fishing pole
